response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior/staff software engineer with deep web, backend, and some embedded/C experience, but he lacks the two hard requirements that dominate this role: native-level Japanese proficiency and demonstrated Linux kernel source-level modification experience. His career has centered on web/backend stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than embedded security, network switching, or L2/L3 protocols, making the core domain fit poor despite his technical strength.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Solid C/C++ background from National Instruments and low-level DLang/async work at Sociomantic
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, lead technical initiatives, and communicate (talks, workshops, open source)
concerns: No mention of Japanese language skills, a mandatory requirement for this role
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation or source-code modification experience
No background in security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection) or L2/L3 switch networking

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded networking/security domain experience
